# Layouts360

## The Essential Real Estate ERP & Digital Layout CRM
Layouts360 replaces outdated spreadsheets and paper maps with interactive digital layouts and a powerful CRM. It is the operating system for modern plot developers and real estate businesses in India.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Replace PDFs**: Convert static maps into interactive, satellite-overlaid digital experiences.
- **Real-Time Inventory**: Track plot availability (Available, Booked, Sold) instantly.
- **Zero Double-Bookings**: Centralized database ensures data integrity.
- **Sales Velocity**: Share plot details via WhatsApp with a single tap.

## Pricing Summary
- **Sales Starter**: ₹2,000/month. Includes Digital Layouts, Plot Management, and Unlimited Users.
- **Growth Suite**: ₹4,000/month. Adds CRM, Lead Management, Booking Tracking, and Payment Records.
- **Setup**: One-time digitization fee starting at ₹10,000 (for 150 plots).

## detailed Features
- **Satellite Overlay**: See plots on actual Google Earth imagery.
- **Mobile Optimized**: designed for field sales agents.
- **Lead CRM**: Capture and track leads from initial call to final booking.
- **Payment Tracking**: Record partial payments and generating payment schedules.
